def_en: 1) to be marvellous, be wonderful, be surpassing, be extraordinary, separate by distinguishing action
1a1) to be beyond one's power, be difficult to do
1c1) to do extraordinary or hard or difficult thing
1d) (Hithpael) to show oneself wonderful or marvellous
kjv: accomplish, (arise...too, be too) hard, hidden, things too high, (be, do, do a, shew) marvelous(-ly, -els, things, work), miracles, perform, separate, make singular, (be, great, make) wonderful(-ers, -ly, things, works), wondrous (things, works, -ly).
expl: properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful
